e.body:
**PensionPro MCP** 是一条**把「养老金行政系统」接给 AI agent** 的开源 MCP 服务器（官方 registry 条目 `io.github.douglaslinsmeyer/pension-pro-mcp`，**v0.2.1，2026-04-05 发布**；仓库 `github.com/douglaslinsmeyer/pension-pro-mcp`）。可核实信息：**MIT 许可**、**★0**、**2026-04-03 创建、2026-04-06 最后推送**、**586 KB**、**Python**、**实测 45 个文件**（含 `pyproject.toml`、`server.json`、`src/pension_pro_mcp/`（`client.py` 等）、**`docs/superpowers/specs/` 与 `docs/superpowers/plans/` 下的设计文档与实施计划**、`scripts/scrape_docs.py` 与 `scripts/swagger.py`、`.github/workflows/publish.yml`、`CLAUDE.md`）。README 自述为「**本地、开源的 MCP 服务器，为 AI 助手提供与 PensionPro REST API 交互的工具**」，能力分五块：**① 计划检索**（按名称/状态/类型/客户搜索计划，返回联系人、周期与**费率表 fee schedules**）；**② 项目与任务流转**（搜索项目、查看任务、完成任务/取消完成、**重新指派任务**、从模板创建项目）；**③ 客户与联系人检索**；**④ 待办管理**（搜索/新建/更新与计划、项目或联系人关联的 to-do）；**⑤ 备注**（在计划、项目、任务、联系人上增删查）。安装方式为 `pip install pension-pro-mcp` 或 **`uvx pension-pro-mcp`**（无需安装直接运行）；前置条件为 **Python 3.12+ 以及 PensionPro 的 API key 与用户名**。

对 RIAA：**它补的是「养老金行政（pension administration）系统 → agent」这一形态**。池内 MCP 已有 16 条，其中[[root-insurance-mcp]] 是**保险核心平台**官方发布的 MCP，本条与之同类但落在**养老金行政**侧——而养老金正是精算的另一条主线（池内有 [[lifeinsurer]]、[[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[open-life-au]]、[[lifepack]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]] 等，但**没有一条是「行政系统接口」**）。它的实际参考价值有两点：**① 形态示范**——「TPA/行政系统的领域对象（计划、周期、费率表、任务、待办）」如何被切成 agent 工具，**任务流转与模板化建项目**这类**运营动作**如何暴露给模型，这套切分对做保险/养老金运营自动化的人直接可借鉴；**② 可读的源码**——45 个文件的仓库结构（含设计文档与实施计划）**可以逐份阅读**，比一个不可审阅的闭源端点更有学习价值（对照：同轮收录的 [[insuranceoracle]] 就属于「无完整源码」的一类）。相关条目：[[lifeinsurer]]、[[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[open-life-au]]、[[lifepack]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[root-insurance-mcp]]、[[latticepolicy]]、[[titanium-insurance-core]]、[[quickfire-ams]]、[[openkoda]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[guidewire-mcp]]。

⚠️ **如实标注三点**：**① 需要账号——它对接的是商业平台 PensionPro，必须持有其 API key 与用户名，没有账号时它只是一份「**怎么写这类接口**」的参考实现**，不能直接使用；**② ★0、最后推送 2026-04-06（此后无活动）**，属**单次发布**、无维护保证，版本 **v0.2.1** 仍早期；**③** 参数与工具清单**以其 README 与仓库结构为据**，本次**未安装、未连接 PensionPro、未实际调用任何工具**（无凭据）。**核实说明**：官方 registry 条目、GitHub 仓库页（300KB）、仓库完整文件树（45 文件）、README 原文均经实测；**未安装、未运行、未连接其上游系统**。
e.body_en:
**PensionPro MCP** is an open-source MCP server that **connects a pension administration system to AI agents** (official registry entry `io.github.douglaslinsmeyer/pension-pro-mcp`, **v0.2.1, published 2026-04-05**; repository `github.com/douglaslinsmeyer/pension-pro-mcp`). Verifiable details: **MIT licence**, **0 stars**, **created 2026-04-03, last pushed 2026-04-06**, **586 KB**, **Python**, with a measured **45 files** (including `pyproject.toml`, `server.json`, `src/pension_pro_mcp/` such as `client.py`, **design and implementation documents under `docs/superpowers/specs/` and `docs/superpowers/plans/`**, `scripts/scrape_docs.py` and `scripts/swagger.py`, `.github/workflows/publish.yml`, `CLAUDE.md`). The README describes it as "**a local, open-source MCP server that provides AI assistants with tools to interact with the PensionPro REST API**", with five capability blocks: **① plan lookup and search** (by name, status, type or client, returning contacts, cycles and **fee schedules**); **② project and task workflow** (search projects, view task details, complete/uncomplete tasks, **reassign tasks**, create projects from templates); **③ client and contact lookup**; **④ to-do management** (search, create and update to-dos linked to plans, projects or contacts); **⑤ notes** (add and retrieve notes on plans, projects, tasks and contacts). Installation is `pip install pension-pro-mcp` or **`uvx pension-pro-mcp`**; prerequisites are **Python 3.12+ and a PensionPro API key and username**.

For RIAA: **it fills the "pension administration system → agent" form.** The corpus holds 16 MCP entries, among them [[root-insurance-mcp]], published by an insurance core platform; this one is the same kind of thing but lands on **pension administration** — and pensions are actuarial work’s other main line (the corpus has [[lifeinsurer]], [[mpf-fund-platform]], [[open-life-au]], [[lifepack]] and [[longevity-mortality-investor]], but **no entry for an administration-system interface**). Its practical value is twofold: **① form demonstration** — how a TPA/administration system’s domain objects (plans, cycles, fee schedules, tasks, to-dos) are cut into agent tools, and how **operational actions** like task transitions and template-driven project creation are exposed to a model; **② readable source** — a 45-file repository (with design documents and implementation plans) **that can actually be read**, which is more instructive than an uninspectable closed endpoint (contrast [[insuranceoracle]], also added this round, which has no complete source). Related: [[lifeinsurer]], [[mpf-fund-platform]], [[open-life-au]], [[lifepack]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]], [[root-insurance-mcp]], [[latticepolicy]], [[titanium-insurance-core]], [[quickfire-ams]], [[openkoda]], [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]], [[guidewire-mcp]].

⚠️ **Three honest caveats**: **① it needs an account** — it talks to the commercial PensionPro platform and requires its API key and username, so **without an account it is only a reference implementation of "how to write this kind of interface"** and cannot be used directly; **② at 0 stars with last push 2026-04-06 (no activity since)**, it is a **single release** with no maintenance guarantee, and v0.2.1 is still early; **③** the parameters and tool list rest **on the README and repository structure**; **nothing was installed, no PensionPro connection was made and no tool was called** (no credentials). **Verification note**: the official registry entry, the GitHub repository page (300KB), the full file tree (45 files) and the README were all measured; **nothing was installed or run, and its upstream system was never contacted**.
e.body_hk:
**PensionPro MCP** 是一條**把「養老金行政系統」接給 AI agent** 的開源 MCP 伺服器（官方 registry 條目 `io.github.douglaslinsmeyer/pension-pro-mcp`，**v0.2.1，2026-04-05 發布**；倉庫 `github.com/douglaslinsmeyer/pension-pro-mcp`）。可核實資訊：**MIT 許可**、**★0**、**2026-04-03 建立、2026-04-06 最後推送**、**586 KB**、**Python**、**實測 45 個檔案**（含 `pyproject.toml`、`server.json`、`src/pension_pro_mcp/`、**`docs/superpowers/specs/` 與 `plans/` 的設計與實施文件**、`scripts/scrape_docs.py` 與 `swagger.py`、`CLAUDE.md`）。README 自述為「**本地、開源的 MCP 伺服器，為 AI 助手提供與 PensionPro REST API 交互的工具**」，能力五塊：**① 計劃檢索**（按名稱/狀態/類型/客戶搜索，返回聯絡人、週期與**費率表**）；**② 項目與任務流轉**（搜索項目、查看任務、完成/取消完成、**重新指派**、從模板建項目）；**③ 客戶與聯絡人**；**④ 待辦管理**；**⑤ 備註**。安裝為 `pip install pension-pro-mcp` 或 **`uvx pension-pro-mcp`**；前置為 **Python 3.12+ 及 PensionPro API key 與用戶名**。

對 RIAA：**它補的是「養老金行政系統 → agent」這一形態**。池內 MCP 已有 16 條，其中 [[root-insurance-mcp]] 是**保險核心平台**官方發布的 MCP，本條同類但落在**養老金行政**側——而養老金正是精算的另一條主線（池內有 [[lifeinsurer]]、[[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[open-life-au]]、[[lifepack]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]，但**沒有一條是「行政系統接口」**）。價值兩點：**① 形態示範**——TPA/行政系統的領域對象（計劃、週期、費率表、任務、待辦）如何切成 agent 工具；**② 可讀的源碼**——45 個檔案的倉庫**可逐份閱讀**，比不可審閱的閉源端點更有學習價值（對照同輪收錄的 [[insuranceoracle]]）。相關：[[lifeinsurer]]、[[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[open-life-au]]、[[lifepack]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[root-insurance-mcp]]、[[latticepolicy]]、[[titanium-insurance-core]]、[[quickfire-ams]]、[[openkoda]]、[[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[guidewire-mcp]]。

⚠️ **如實標注三點**：**① 需要帳號**——對接商業平台 PensionPro，必須持有其 API key 與用戶名，**沒有帳號時它只是一份「怎麼寫這類接口」的參考實現**；**② ★0、最後推送 2026-04-06（此後無活動）**，屬**單次發布**；**③** 參數與工具清單**以 README 與倉庫結構為據**，本次**未安裝、未連接 PensionPro、未實際調用**。**核實說明**：registry 條目、倉庫頁（300KB）、完整文件樹（45 檔案）、README 原文均實測；**未安裝、未運行**。
